summary: Jose Alfredo Lopez-Diaz, 49, of Arvada, killed in an apparent solo ATV crash on Glacier Ridge near Georgia Pass; likely crashed and ended up beneath his ATV; no one saw the incident; an unrelated group found him unresponsive and messaged for help with a satellite messaging device (no cell coverage on the Divide); rescuers arrived but could not resuscitate him; pronounced dead on scene. He was wearing a helmet.
location: Glacier Ridge near Georgia Pass, Continental Divide
notes: Parks the run-643 SCSO-blotter '~early Sep 2025 Apple satellite-device ATV fatality in Summit backcountry' lead (cross-anchored via the SCSO statement; 2025-08-31 Sunday-verified, Labor Day weekend 2025).
